problem_text:
A logistics company must allocate the distribution of a specialized commodity from nine regional storage facilities to nine retail outlets in order to minimize total handling and transit expenses.

The inventory available at each storage facility is precisely fixed:
* Facility R1 holds 91 units.
* Facility R2 holds 177 units.
* Facility R3 holds 138 units.
* Facility R4 holds 183 units.
* Facility R5 holds 182 units.
* Facility R6 holds 116 units.
* Facility R7 holds 92 units.
* Facility R8 holds 145 units.
* Facility R9 holds 82 units.

The contractual requirement that must be satisfied at each retail outlet is explicitly defined:
* Outlet S1 requires 177 units.
* Outlet S2 requires 148 units.
* Outlet S3 requires 24 units.
* Outlet S4 requires 182 units.
* Outlet S5 requires 68 units.
* Outlet S6 requires 87 units.
* Outlet S7 requires 105 units.
* Outlet S8 requires 53 units.
* Outlet S9 requires 196 units.

The per-unit expense for transferring the commodity from any given storage facility to any specific retail outlet is detailed in the following matrix:

| From / To | S1 | S2 | S3 | S4 | S5 | S6 | S7 | S8 | S9 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| R1 | 3 | 16 | 15 | 17 | 12 | 2 | 16 | 19 | 6 |
| R2 | 12 | 6 | 9 | 4 | 19 | 4 | 8 | 17 | 1 |
| R3 | 2 | 1 | 8 | 2 | 16 | 12 | 13 | 5 | 6 |
| R4 | 2 | 18 | 14 | 8 | 11 | 8 | 14 | 11 | 9 |
| R5 | 3 | 19 | 12 | 4 | 17 | 2 | 6 | 8 | 17 |
| R6 | 2 | 13 | 3 | 15 | 10 | 10 | 11 | 3 | 18 |
| R7 | 15 | 1 | 12 | 7 | 10 | 19 | 10 | 20 | 8 |
| R8 | 15 | 12 | 19 | 16 | 7 | 18 | 8 | 5 | 1 |
| R9 | 14 | 1 | 8 | 18 | 12 | 1 | 11 | 1 | 13 |

Determine the optimal allocation of commodity flows that minimizes the aggregate expenditure.
